builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Zaahen: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A sustained melee fighter who builds Determination through repeated champion hits and uses healing/control to reach its empowered state. Edge placement on E and timing R's damage reduction improve his fighting window. Record Determination ramp, Q recast, E edge and R cast damage reduction. The empowered state and max-health healing must actually occur before crediting sustained value. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Zaahen: Record Determination ramp, Q recast, E edge and R cast damage reduction. The empowered state and max-health healing must actually occur before crediting sustained value.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The route fails Zaahen's stated kit question: Record Determination ramp, Q recast, E edge and R cast damage reduction. The empowered state and max-health healing must actually occur before crediting sustained value.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max [12]). He gains [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)] increased Attack Damage per stack.

When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for [4] seconds then revives with [UNRESOLVED({4ce08984}; see calculationRaw)] of his max Health.

Zaahen's revive has a [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=300, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown.

Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing [15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 + (0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] bonus physical damage and restoring [(0.05 / 0.06 / 0.07 / 0.08 / 0.09) × 100]% of his max Health.

Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for [0.75] seconds.

Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies.

Enemies at the edge of the slice take [(40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.5)] physical damage +[(0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06) × 100]% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead.

Passive: Zaahen gains [(0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3) × 100]% %i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration.

Active: Zaahen rises, gaining [50]% Damage Reduction while casting.

Zaahen then stabs downward, dealing [250 / 400 / 550 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and restoring [33]% of the damage dealt to enemy champions as Health.

Zaahen stabs in a direction, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies hit, then Pulls them toward him, dealing [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
